newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-VOGTS CALLS UP FIVE NEWCOMERS FOR ARMENIA GAME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VOGTS CALLS UP FIVE NEWCOMERS FOR ARMENIA GAME.

text.p: Berti Vogts on Monday named five newcomers in his squad for Germany's opening World Cup qualifier against Armenia in Yerevan next week.

Hamburg striker Karsten Baeron, defenders Stephan Passlack (Borussia Moenchengladbach) and Thomas Schneider (VfB Stuttgart) and midfielders Michael Tarnat (Karlsruhe) and Dariusz Wosz (Bochum) were the lucky five to get their first call-up.
But the coach also kept faith with the backbone of his European championship-winning team in the 26-man squad which will be cut back to 18 after this weekend's league fixtures.
Juergen Klinsmann, Thomas Haessler, Dieter Eilts and Andy Moeller are all in the squad for the group nine tie, which could prove awkward for Vogts's side.
The Armenians held Switzerland to a 0-0 draw in the opening match of their qualifying campaign earlier this month.
Goalkeepers - Oliver Kahn, Andreas Koepke, Oliver Reck.
Defenders - Markus Babbel, Juergen Kohler, Stephan Passlack, Stefan Reuter, Thomas Schneider.
Midfielders - Mario Basler, Marco Bode, Dieter Eilts, Thomas Haessler, Joerg Heinrich, Andreas Moeller, Mehmet Scholl, Thomas Strunz, Michael Tarnat, Jens Todt, Dariusz Wosz, Christian Ziege.
Strikers - Karsten Baeron, Oliver Bierhoff, Fredi Bobic, Heiko Herrlich, Juergen Klinsmann, Stefan Kuntz.
